scope: The newest finished cc-matrix runs: the 2026-11-01 14:09 and 18:43 batches, riffs on a famous book, movie and TV show (Moby-Dick, Alice in Wonderland, Jaws, Raiders of the Lost Ark, Home Alone, Ghostbusters, Jurassic Park, Seinfeld, LOST, The X-Files, Scooby-Doo, MythBusters, Takeshi’s Castle, The Office) by Claude Opus 5.5 (medium, xhigh) and Claude Sonnet 5.5 (medium). The 14:09 games are pixel art on the my-3D2dge engine (v0.85.1, inlined); the 18:43 games are three.js r180 WebGPU with Rapier 0.19.3.
dedupePolicy: A run was new only if ingest found no matching page in games/ or data/import-registry.json; ingest reported 24 imports and 0 duplicates. The 12 runs of the 17:15 batch were interrupted (no result.json) and are left out; their partial pages are listed under skipped.
filenamePolicy: The run’s own Title-SOURCE-model-effort-YYYYMMDD-HHMM.html, unchanged, except Chainfeld, whose run wrote its file as [Chainfeld-…].html: the square brackets were dropped. Imported with scripts/ingest.mjs (provenance sourceKind cc-matrix-run, artifactId = run id, sourceDate = run startedAt), which moved three r180 and Rapier 0.19.3 onto the local shelf.
capturePolicy: Real GPU (RTX 4070, WebGPU in headless Windows Chrome over CDP), each game in a window of its own at 960x720, encoded 640x480 JPEG quality 58. Each game was shot every 4 s for 74 s and three frames were picked by eye: the title, then two of the attract demo the prompt requires after 10 s idle. Twelve windows at once starved the three.js games of frames, so those were reshot three at a time.
notes: Ingest bug fixed in the same change: shelf scopes mapped three/webgpu and three/tsl to the unminified builds even when the page mapped them to the .min ones, so an addon (Mopey Dick’s BloomNode) pulled in a second three core and the WebGPU shaders failed. Scopes now follow the page’s own entry files; Mopey Dick and Moby Duck were re-ingested with it and run cleanly. Brave Fencer Mushimaru and StarMischief 64 on the wall carry the same mismatch but import no addons, so they were left as they are.
Every game ran on the real GPU without an uncaught error; the only console error is the browser’s own /favicon.ico 404.
All 24 declare a hub session. Co-op, versus and race games seat 1–4 and carry their mode as a tag; parallel ones keep the game’s own local player count (hub:players), or 1.
Taglines come from each title screen; controls from each game’s hub:session-howto and its header comment.

metadata.name: Moby-Dusk
metadata.tagline: A whaling voyage after Herman Melville
metadata.description: Moby-Dusk is an original pixel-art whaling adventure after Moby-Dick: sail from Nantucket to the Line, lower the boats for the hunt, gam with other ships and follow the story chapter by chapter to the White Whale.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to steer, R and F for more or less sail, Space to lower the boats, Shift to row, hold L to aim the iron, M for the chart, V to switch view

metadata.name: Moby-Hike
metadata.tagline: A Voyage After the White Whale
metadata.description: Moby-Hike is an original naval adventure after Moby-Dick: sail out of Nantucket, lower the whaleboat, fight the line on a Nantucket sleigh-ride, ride out the storm and row together against the White Whale.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to row and steer, right click to aim, click to throw a dart, Q to dodge, F to lance

metadata.name: PAUSE
metadata.tagline: Don’t go back in the water
metadata.description: PAUSE is an original pixel-art shark hunt after Jaws: patrol an island town’s beaches, chum the water, harpoon sharks and rescue stranded swimmers across four story chapters and the Shark Derby score attack.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to steer, mouse to aim, J or Space to harpoon, K to chum, hold E to patch leaks, Shift for throttle, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Ghostbustle
metadata.tagline: Licensed. Bonded. Mostly insured.
metadata.description: Ghostbustle is an original co-op ghost-wrangling game after Ghostbusters: take jobs from the board, trap a buffet-eating Gobbler in a hotel ballroom, scan a library for invisible spirits and keep the property damage down.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, mouse to aim, click to stream, F to throw the trap, hold Tab to reveal invisible ghosts, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Grainfeld
metadata.tagline: A game about nothing. Episode One: The Pumpernickel Swirl
metadata.description: Grainfeld is an original pixel-art social comedy after Seinfeld: wander one block, jot observations for your act, return bottles, dodge the super and the close talker, beat the bread line and win the room in a banter duel.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, E to use, Q to observe, Shift to tiptoe

metadata.name: Seinfeld-ish
metadata.tagline: A game about nothing. Mostly.
metadata.description: Seinfeld-ish is an original 3D social comedy after Seinfeld: one episode from the cold open through the apartment and the diner to a stand-up set, with errands, banter, a runaway wheel of Gouda and a soup line to survive.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, E to talk, Q to observe, F to push, V to switch camera

metadata.name: The X-Miles
metadata.tagline: The Miles Are Out There
metadata.description: The X-Miles is an original pixel-art paranormal investigation after The X-Files: two agents examine crop circles and farm towns, file evidence, sneak past men in black and hold out against greys and a UFO, together.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, mouse to aim, Q for the beam, J to fire, E to examine, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Mythmusters
metadata.tagline: Four myths. One crash-test dummy. Zero sensible precautions.
metadata.description: Mythmusters is an original physics-experiment game after MythBusters: build the rig, set the charge, run the test, watch it again in slow motion and call each of four myths Confirmed, Plausible or Busted.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to adjust, Space to run the test, F for the big boom, W for gas, C to switch camera

metadata.name: Alice's Adventures in Ponderland
metadata.tagline: A nonsense in six chapters, after Lewis Carroll
metadata.description: Alice's Adventures in Ponderland is an original grow-and-shrink platformer after Lewis Carroll: six nonsense chapters from the riverbank to the Pool of Tears and beyond, a boss fight, and a Caucus-Race for up to four.
metadata.controls: Arrows or stick to move, Space to jump (hold to float), Q to shrink, E to grow

metadata.name: Mopey Dick
metadata.tagline: or, The Melancholy Whale
metadata.description: Mopey Dick is an original naval whaling adventure after Moby-Dick: a four-chapter story from the first lowering to the White Whale, plus A Gam, a versus race for the most barrels of oil, at sea under a dusk sky.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to row, Space to throw the iron, E to lance, Q to cut the line, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Zone Alone
metadata.tagline: A holiday home-defense comedy
metadata.description: Zone Alone is an original pixel-art home-defense comedy after Home Alone: left behind for the holidays, plan traps by day across a two-storey house, then hold off two bumbling burglars until 11:30 PM.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, Space to set traps, J for the slingshot, R to holler, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Ghost Bustlers
metadata.tagline: A spiritual successor to the 1984 spook-com
metadata.description: Ghost Bustlers is an original co-op ghost-wrangling game after Ghostbusters: stream, wrangle and trap ghosts through a hotel ballroom, a library and a rooftop finale, then pay the itemised bill for the damage.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, left click to stream, E to throw the trap, right click to slam while wrangling

metadata.name: Seinbound
metadata.tagline: A game about nothing. Episode 1: The Rain Check
metadata.description: Seinbound is an original pixel-art comedic RPG after Seinfeld, in the EarthBound tradition: four plots, banter battles against a close talker and a double dipper, a stand-up set, and a 1–4 player party mode.
metadata.controls: WASD or arrows to move, Enter or Space to confirm, E for the leader’s ability (hold to observe), Tab for the notebook, Q and R to switch friend, Shift to hurry, V for the Sitcom Cam

metadata.name: Chainfeld
metadata.tagline: A game about nothing
metadata.description: Chainfeld is an original 3D ensemble comedy after Seinfeld: switch between four friends on one city block, run petty errands, set off chain reactions, survive the Broth Baron and close the night with a stand-up set.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, hold E at errands, F to shove, R for each friend’s special, Shift to hurry

metadata.name: Spoopy-Doo!
metadata.tagline: The Phantom of Fogmoor Manor
metadata.description: Spoopy-Doo! is an original Saturday-morning mystery after Scooby-Doo: split up through a haunted manor, sniff out five clues, keep a cowardly Great Dane brave with snacks, build the trap and pull the mask off the Phantom.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, E to search and hide, Q for the character’s ability, Shift to run

metadata.name: Takeshi's Rascal Castle
metadata.tagline: The gameshow where everyone falls over
metadata.description: Takeshi's Rascal Castle is an original physics party platformer after Takeshi's Castle: burst through paper doors, hop the plop stones, survive the Spin Cycle, dodge foam boulders, cross Cannon Bridge and storm the castle.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, Space to jump, Shift to dive, C to duck

metadata.name: Moby Duck
metadata.tagline: or, The Whale That Quacks
metadata.description: Moby Duck is an original arcade whaling game after Moby-Dick: row a whaleboat through the fishery and a gale, harpoon whales and ride the Nantucket sleigh-ride, then chase down a white whale with a duck’s bill.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to steer, mouse to aim, Space to throw the harpoon, F to lance

metadata.name: Jurassic Parsec
metadata.tagline: A parsec from anywhere. Ninety seconds from dinner.
metadata.description: Jurassic Parsec is an original third-person survival game after Jurassic Park: restore power to the park’s pump houses at night, collect DNA amber, hold off raptors with tranquilizer darts and flares, and escape.
metadata.controls: WASD to move, mouse to look, click to fire a dart, F for a flare, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Close Talker Chronicles
metadata.tagline: A spiritual successor to Seinfeld
metadata.description: Close Talker Chronicles is an original third-person comedy action game after Seinfeld: five episodes on one Upper West Side block, from chasing the last marble rye to the soup line, the parking garage, a Festivus boss and a stand-up round.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, F to retort, Shift to dodge, G to throw, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Conference Room Crush
metadata.tagline: A spiritual successor to the world’s most awkward workplace
metadata.description: Conference Room Crush is an original office brawler after The Office: survive waves of auditors and paper-pushers across shifts, chain combos with staplers and swivel chairs, and call a Mandatory Meeting to clear the floor.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, mouse to look, Space to jump, J or click to attack, K or right click to throw, Shift to roll, E to grab, Q for a Mandatory Meeting, V to switch camera

metadata.name: Alice in Jabberland
metadata.tagline: A nonsense in four chapters, after Lewis Carroll
metadata.description: Alice in Jabberland is an original pixel-art action adventure after Alice's Adventures in Wonderland: fall down the rabbit-hole, drink and eat to shrink or grow, cross the Queen's rose garden in four chapters and face the Jabberwock.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, E to talk, J to swing, Space to roll, Q to drink (shrink), R to eat (grow), T to stop time, V for the camera

metadata.name: Raiders of the Lost Card
metadata.tagline: A spiritual successor to Raiders of the Lost Ark
metadata.description: Raiders of the Lost Card is an original pulp action platformer after Raiders of the Lost Ark: whip and shoot through a trapped temple, the bazaars and rooftops of Cairo and an airstrip, after the Jade Joker.
metadata.controls: Arrows or WASD to move, Space to jump, X or J to whip, C or L to shoot, Shift to roll, E to use, V to change the view

metadata.name: Seinfence
metadata.tagline: A game about nothing. Mostly a fence.
metadata.description: Seinfence is an original pixel-art social-stealth sitcom after Seinfeld: switch between four friends with petty plots on one Upper West Side block, dodge awkward people, order soup the right way and gather material for the 8 PM set.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, E to talk, F for the friend’s ability, C to hide, L1 and R1 on a pad to switch friend

metadata.name: Lost Numbers
metadata.description: Lost Numbers is an original pixel-art survival mystery after LOST: pull supplies from the burning wreck, hunt boars, open the hatch, enter the numbers before the clock runs out and sneak past the Others.
metadata.controls: WASD or stick to move, J to swing, E to use, Shift to sprint, V to switch camera
